rules.per_page_rule: one sequence instance per downsell page: the instance is bound to exactly one approved downsell page and its smaller option; the three emails never mix pages and never sell the main offer or a larger upsell
rules.cta_destination: the matching downsell page for this instance (the smaller option bound to that page); never the sales page, checkout, or a second offer
rules.timing_rule: relative to the decline and the approved launch calendar in the brief: E1 after the decline is recorded, E2 and E3 spaced across the follow-up window the brief supplies; every date, deadline, or countdown comes from the brief, never invented
rules.objective_note: the frozen objective enum already carries downsell; this profile uses it and must never widen the enum from a lane file
rules.face_saving_rule: the copy acknowledges the no without arguing with it: no guilt, no re-pitching the declined offer, no implying the reader was wrong; the smaller option is framed as a right-sized first step, and declining it too is accepted plainly

variant_pairing.pairing: subject and preview are paired per variant (Pair A = subject A + preview A; Pair B = subject B + preview B); pairs are preserved through the Skill-44 draft handoff, never flattened into unpaired lists
variant_pairing.pair_b_style: prolific and disruptive, truthful and on brand (no false account alert, no fake reply prefix, no fabricated urgency, no fake scarcity, no misleading price)

rules.intake: the approved S49 shared-launch brief, consumed by the launch intake adapter with per-field provenance; the legacy one-block questionnaire applies only in explicit legacy interactive mode
rules.review_labels: the private client-review document labels each email with its framework and labels the body 'Email Body:'; the recipient payload carries no framework labels, slot instructions, or production commentary
rules.trigger: Signature Launch build: after a contact declines the main offer or the preceding upsell, the matching downsell follow-up offers the smaller option on that downsell page; one instance per downsell page, from the approved launch brief and the approved downsell page
rules.stop_rules: stop on purchase of the main offer, the smaller option, or any later upsell; a purchase moves the contact to access/welcome and the next follow-up, never to remaining downsell emails; a second decline ends the sequence with no further promotional send
rules.registration_note: not yet in catalog-index.json / catalog-built-index.json and not yet in SEQ_LENGTHS / PREVIEW_EXPECTED / _sequence_type; until the integrator registers the profile, a run resolving sequence_type signature_launch_downsell fails AF-EMAIL-TYPE-MISMATCH by design
